Advanced Search: Add a condition to narrow the search by name, contents, size, date, folder, tag or regular expression.

Advanced Search: Separate extensions with semicolons; an item matches any of them.
高级搜索: 用分号分隔多个扩展名，匹配其中任意一个即可。

Advanced Search: Separate words with spaces to find names that contain all of them, in any order.
高级搜索: 用空格分隔多个词，查找名称中同时包含这些词的项目，顺序不限。

Advanced Search: * stands for any run of characters and ? for exactly one; a pattern with wildcards has to match the whole name. In a path, ** spans any number of folders.
高级搜索: * 代表任意数量的字符，? 代表一个字符；含通配符的模式必须匹配整个名称。在路径中，** 可跨越任意层文件夹。

Advanced Search: OR or | accepts either side, NOT or ! leaves matches out, and parentheses group conditions. NOT is applied first, then OR, then AND.
高级搜索: OR 或 | 表示满足任一侧即可，NOT 或 ! 用于排除匹配项，括号用于分组。优先级依次为 NOT、OR、AND。

Advanced Search: Wrap phrases with spaces or operators in English double quotes. A filter's value follows its colon directly; semicolons list alternatives.
高级搜索: 包含空格或运算符的短语请用英文双引号括起来。筛选器的值紧跟在冒号之后；用分号列出多个候选值。

Advanced Search: A word with a slash matches names along the path: /name/ is a whole name, name/ the end of one, /name the start of one. Add /** to list everything inside a folder.
高级搜索: 含斜杠的词会匹配路径上的名称：/name/ 表示完整名称，name/ 表示名称结尾，/name 表示名称开头。末尾加 /** 可列出文件夹中的全部内容。

高级搜索: infolder:（或 parent:）搜索文件夹及其子文件夹；nosubfolders: 只搜索直接位于其中的项目。~ 代表你的个人文件夹。

Advanced Search: ext: matches extensions; type: picks a category such as image, video, audio, doc, spreadsheet, archive or code. file: and folder: keep only files or only folders.
高级搜索: ext: 匹配扩展名；type: 选择类别，例如 image、video、audio、doc、spreadsheet、archive 或 code。file: 和 folder: 只保留文件或只保留文件夹。

Advanced Search: Compare with >, >=, <, <=, = or != and write ranges as 10KB..2MB. Units are B, KB, MB, GB, TB and PB (1 KB = 1000 bytes). empty, tiny, small, medium, large, huge and gigantic name preset ranges.
高级搜索: 可用 >、>=、<、<=、= 或 != 比较，范围写作 10KB..2MB。单位为 B、KB、MB、GB、TB 和 PB（1 KB = 1000 字节）。empty、tiny、small、medium、large、huge 和 gigantic 代表预设的大小范围。

Advanced Search: dm: is the modification date and dc: the creation date. Use today, yesterday, pastweek, thismonth or lastyear, dates written as YYYY-MM-DD, comparisons and ranges.
高级搜索: dm: 表示修改日期，dc: 表示创建日期。可使用 today、yesterday、pastweek、thismonth 或 lastyear，也可使用 YYYY-MM-DD 格式的日期、比较和范围。

Advanced Search: content: finds text stored literally in files. It does not read text inside PDF or Word documents, and a smaller scope makes it faster.
高级搜索: content: 查找以原文形式存储在文件中的文字，不会读取 PDF 或 Word 文档中的文字；搜索范围越小，速度越快。

Advanced Search: regex: tests the item name with a regular expression and follows Match Case.
高级搜索: regex: 用正则表达式匹配项目名称，并遵循“区分大小写”设置。

Advanced Search: tag: finds items with a Finder tag whose name contains the value; list several with semicolons.
高级搜索: tag: 查找 Finder 标签名称包含该值的项目；多个值用分号分隔。

Advanced Search: case: makes the next word or group, or on its own the whole search, case-sensitive; nocase: does the opposite.
高级搜索: case: 让后面的词或分组区分大小写，单独使用时作用于整个搜索；nocase: 的作用相反。
